name: app-lime-black-watch-screens-with-giant-ghost-countdown
title: Seven smartwatch screens in lime, black and white around a giant ghost 2:47 timer
whatItIs: A tall white board with an outlined 'Apple Watch App' pill and watch screens on soft shadows: a voice-listening lime blur, ride in progress, profile stats, a home with a lime Book a ride button, a large watch 'Arriving now 2:47 min' over huge faint numerals, a route confirm and an 'You arrived!' summary, with two small explanation texts.
whatItMeans: Precise and focused; each watch screen carries one datum.
techniques: Show each state as a separate watch.
Enlarge the hero screen over giant ghost numerals.

vocabulary.definition: Screens showing each stage of a flow.
A blurred sphere indicating voice input.
